name: frost
description: A window freezing over: ice ferns grow from its frame in Kobayashi's phase field for a growing crystal, stepped on the GPU, and the glass fogs between them. A finger melts it clear and it freezes over again. WebGL2 and GLSL, no dependencies.
author: Oliver Kure Olsen (https://work.draindk.tech)

scripts.build: esbuild demo/main.ts --bundle --minify --format=esm --target=es2022 --outdir=docs && cp demo/index.html demo/public/* docs/
scripts.dev: npm run build && npx --yes serve docs
